title: Line numberer
brief: Print the input with each line prefixed by its number, a colon and a space, counting from 1. Blank lines get a number too. A last line with no newline still counts as a line, and the output should end it with a newline.
hints: A rule can match a whole line at once. In flex, . matches anything except a newline.
Write one rule for a line with its newline, .*\n, and one for a final line without one, .+
Use printf with %s and yytext. For the first rule, yytext already ends with the newline.
explanation: .*\n and .+ cover every case between them. The first takes a complete line, including an empty one. The second only fires when the input ends without a newline, because otherwise the first rule is longer.
